title: HATEDAY: Insights from a Global Hate Speech Dataset Representative of a Day on Twitter

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the average precision of public hate speech detection models across eight different languages (Arabic, English, French, German, Indonesian, Portuguese, Spanish, Turkish) using a representative real-world Twitter dataset.

Measuring and comparing hate speech detection performance and prevalence across four distinct English-speaking countries (India, Kenya, Nigeria, and the United States) to identify regional disparities.

Comparing the distribution of hate speech target categories (e.g., political, gender, racial, religious, sexual orientation) in academic training datasets against their actual prevalence in real-world data, and correlating this alignment with model detection performance.
